profile.name: Warren Scantlebury
profile.title: Full Stack Software Engineer
profile.summary: Results-oriented Software Engineer with a Master’s in Computer Science and significant experience in building scalable web applications. Expert in TypeScript (Node.js/React) and DevOps (GCP/Kubernetes). Proven track record of architecting serverless APIs and leading frontend initiatives.

achievements.org: Emerging Networks and Services in Developing Nations -- Barbados Use Case
achievements.note: Co-authored with Supervising Professor, Dr. Milena Radenkovic

experience.title: Independent Software Consultant
details: Sole trader consultancy taking on end-to-end product work for small businesses: scoping, build, deployment and handover, with the client owning the result.
Designed and delivered the public website and enrolment platform for Bright Sparks Tutoring Agency end to end, from requirements and copy through launch and handover.
Built it on Next.js, React and Firebase (Firestore, Auth, Cloud Functions): a multi-step enrolment form with validation, a role-based admin dashboard, and email notifications for new enrolments.
Owned delivery and operations: GitHub Actions deploys to Firebase App Hosting, Cypress end-to-end tests, honeypot and reCAPTCHA v3 bot protection, and a documented daily backup plan for submissions.

experience.title: Software Engineering Consultant
details: Architected full-stack applications using TypeScript, React (Next.js), and Node.js, serving as a core contributor.
Engineered cloud infrastructure on GCP using Terraform and Helm, implementing GitOps workflows.
Orchestrated containerized microservices on Kubernetes, integrating Kafka for event streaming and BigQuery.

experience.title: Software Engineer
details: Developed high-performance educational platforms using Agile methodologies.
Built secure video conferencing features in Next.js integrating AWS Chime SDK and AWS Cognito.

experience.title: Software Engineer
details: Lead Frontend Developer for an Angular 9 election application, implementing complex Internationalization.
Co-developed a company-wide Design System focused on Accessibility using Web Components and Vue.js.

experience.title: Web Developer
details: Designed and deployed a critical internal RESTful API central to daily operations.
Developed serverless microservices using AWS Lambda and API Gateway.
